The '''Crash Survival Kit''' was a popular model of [[Survival kit/Legends|survival kit]] manufactured by [[Pretormin Environmental/Legends|Pretormin Environmental]]. It included a [[Thermal cloak/Legends|thermal cloak]], multipurpose [[Knife/Legends|knife]], [[Distress beacon/Legends|distress beacon]], two emergency [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]], wire spool, [[Ration bar/Legends|ration bars]], a basic [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]], two [[Breath mask/Legends|respirators]], [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Water filter|filter]] and jug, a [[Glowrod/Legends|glow rod]], 50 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] of high strength [[microfiber]], ten [[Ration pack/Legends|ration packs]], and a [[flare gun]]. Some [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] augmented their kits with compact [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] or other weapons, though this was not standard. The kit cost 300 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="EOTEC" />
